My current foster dog. He came to me in March with his hind legs paralyzed due to a sever in his sacrum, legs atrophied to hell (think Family Guy's creepy neighbor's dog) incontinent, and in kidney failure. The first vet said there was no hope for him and we should think in terms of quality of life. We got a second opinion and discovered he had some (very, very little, but enough for hope) sensation in his hind legs and was optimistic she could get his incontinence under control through pulsed signal therapy. That, medicine, a homemade diet, and some months of intense physical therapy and he's no longer any of those things. His walk is a little dopey and he gets tired easily, but he's still making strides. He's been on the news twice and is a little local celebrity at events. On top of it all, he hasn't one mean bone in his body. He just wants to be loved on 24/7.

Edit: Oh, and I named him Lt. Dan.
